# bintables/as

> Conversions: u8 keeps the low byte, bool tests for non-zero, others keep the bits.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/as.pkg) · translates [std/as](../std/as.md)

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when t u8`

```nasm
{v}
movzx eax, al
```

### `emit when t bool`

```nasm
{v}
test rax, rax
setne al
movzx eax, al
```

### `emit`

```nasm
{v}
```
